intro.title: Star Rating Component
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build an interactive Star Rating component that allows users to select and display a rating from one to five stars. You will learn how to manage component state to track the current rating and the user's hover selection. The core programming concepts involve using React's useState hook for state management and handling user events like clicks and mouse interactions. You'll implement this by creating a reusable component that renders star icons and updates visually based on user input, using JSX for structure and JavaScript for logic.
intro.usecase: Star rating components are essential interactive UI elements found across modern web applications. You'll implement them in e-commerce product pages for customer reviews, in streaming platforms for content ratings, and in feedback forms for user satisfaction surveys. As a React developer, you'll build these reusable components to collect user input and display aggregated ratings consistently. Mastering this pattern prepares you for real-world scenarios like creating review systems for marketplaces or rating interfaces for service platforms.
